description: This file defines a SwiftUI to AppKit bridge component 'MenuHostedItem' that allows embedding SwiftUI views inside an AppKit menu item by wrapping them in an NSHostingView. It manages sizing and updates to the embedded view for menu display.

classes.name: MenuHostedItem
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that hosts an arbitrary SwiftUI view inside an AppKit menu item, handling sizing and rendering by wrapping the content in an NSHostingView.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and returns an NSHostingView containing the rootView, applying sizing constraints.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the existing NSHostingView with the current rootView and re-applies sizing.

methods.name: applySizing
methods.description: Adjusts the size of NSHostingView based on the specified width and its fitting size.
